en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, from one of his companions, 
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘Make the new-born to taste the water of the Euphrates, and (recite) Iqaama in his ear’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ’Isma‘il ibn Marrar from Yunus from certain persons of his people who have said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Drops of water from Euphrates or water from the sky should be dropped in the newborn’s mouth and Iqamah should be said in his ear.’”
